extraction.Name: Louise Drapeau
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739684 issued under the 'Declaration of Policy.' Application for patent in fee signed by Louise Drapeau on January 2, 1920, before Sara M. Shotwell, Notary Public. Letter refers to Circular 2464, superintendent's letter of December 11, 1928, and Office letter of January 5, 1929. Superintendent E. E. McKean inquired whether the Office desired information called for in Circular 2464 in view of the application on file.
